sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri Himanshu Dubey, learned counsel for the applicant Sri Ram Prakash Shukla, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.
3.

This bail application under Section 483 BNSS has been filed by the applicant-Vikas Kumar Alias Vikki, seeking release on bail in connection with Case Crime No. 178 of 2022, under Sections 419,
420, 468, 471, 493, 328, 354(C), 376, 506 IPC and Section 7/8 POCSO Act, 2012, P.S. Pipari,
District Sonbhadra.
4. Learned counsel for State points that as per his instructions apart from the present case, the applicant is reported to be involved in five other cases which have not been disclosed and explained.

He submits that the bail application be dismissed in view of the order/judgement of the Apex Court passed in the cases of Munnesh Vs. State of U.P.: SLP (Crl.) No. 1400 / 2025 and Kaushal Singh Vs.
State of Rajasthan : 2025 SCC OnLine SC 1473.
5.

7. The bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.
